entry.title: Lubiechów Palm House entrance garden
entry.note: The maintained garden at the Palm House entrance uses three mapped lawns around the native loop path. Operator photos guide the urn, clipped topiary and timber benches. The exact plant species, ornaments and dates of changes are interpreted. Former nursery plots and the wider castle park are outside this placement.

terrainReference.basis: The landscaped lawn surfaces and edging follow the retained terrain samples at the landcover surface around the native loop path.

review: Three landscaped lawns sit above the rendered land-cover surface. All four detail levels leave the mapped loop path, entrance and service road clear.
